title: Post-incident review automation
description: Auto-generates a post-incident review document with timeline, changes, metrics, and impact data.
example_prompt: "Incident on resource '{resource_id}' from {start_time} to {end_time} is now resolved. Generate a post-incident review: (1) timeline of events (first alert → detection → response → resolution), (2) changes made during and before incident, (3) metrics during impact window, (4) user/customer impact estimate, (5) action items to prevent recurrence."
